title: MemArena：面向设备端智能个人记忆助手的自我中心基准测试
summary: MemArena是一个用于评估设备端个人记忆助手的基准测试，通过MASim模拟器生成50个代理15天的对话数据，涵盖六种记忆评估维度。研究发现记忆后端选择比模型扩展更重要，权限感知访问普遍失败，搜索延迟影响较小。
summary_en: MemArena is a benchmark for evaluating on-device personal memory assistants, using the MASim simulator to generate 50 agents' 15-day conversations and assessing six memory dimensions. Findings show memory backend choice matters more than model scaling, permission-aware access fails universally, and search latency has limited impact.
